meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Guides a refactor, cleanup, or restructure with the right decomposition. Use when the user asks to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将混乱代码改造成清晰结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 代码越来越乱,想在不改功能的前提下变得清晰好维护。
copy.tagline_en: Restructure messy code into a clear, maintainable design.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase is messy and you want to clean it up without changing behavior.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按阶段做重构:先确认目标,再并行探查代码库、画依赖与影响范围、评估测试覆盖,出计划后用 LSP 和 AST-grep 逐步改,每步跑测试校验,最后整体验证。
howto.when: 当你要重构、简化、抽取或现代化代码时触发;也可直接调用 /refactor 加目标,并配合 --scope 与 --strategy 两个参数。

say.note: 默认 module 范围、safe 策略。

say.text: 把 AuthService 里的校验逻辑抽成独立模块
say.note: 它会先确认目标再出计划。

say.text: 重构项目里所有废弃 API 的调用
say.note: 加 --scope=project 覆盖整个代码库。

howto.what_en: Installed, Claude refactors in phases: clarify the goal, explore the codebase, map dependencies, check test coverage, plan, then edit via LSP and AST-grep, running tests after each step and a full check at the end.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code; you can call /refactor with a target plus --scope and --strategy options.

say_en.note: Defaults to module scope and safe strategy.

say_en.text: Extract the validation logic from AuthService into its own module
Refactor every call to the deprecated API across the project
say_en.note: Use --scope=project to cover the whole codebase.
